name: 全国Q地図
description: Individually operated map portal built on the open-source GSI Maps (地理院地図) code, publishing original layer collections: 赤色立体地図 / CS立体図, 森林基本図, 法務局地図, 全国橋梁マップ, 全国農業用ため池マップ, バス停留所マップ and historical topographic maps.

name: OH3 (Open Hinata 3)
description: Free public WebGIS built on the open-hinata3 fork of ひなたGIS with 700+ layers for Japan: 登記所備付地図 (地図XML), 地番図, aerial photos, hazard and statistical layers, aimed at land surveyors and real-estate research.

name: ぷらっと会津若松
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer overlaying historical maps of Aizuwakamatsu City (Fukushima) on the modern map.

name: ぷらっといわき
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer overlaying historical maps of Iwaki City (Fukushima) on the modern map.

name: ぷらっと水戸
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer with old maps of Mito City (Ibaraki), built with Mito and Ibaraki prefectural library collections and Mito open data.

name: ぷらっと玉村
owner_name: Gunma Historical Materials Preservation Network (ぐんま史料ネット)
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer with historical maps of Tamamura Town (Gunma), by the Gunma Historical Materials Preservation Network.

name: ぷらっと館林
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer overlaying historical maps of Tatebayashi City (Gunma) on the modern map.

name: ぷらっと東京中央区
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer overlaying historical maps of Chuo Ward (Tokyo) on the modern map.

name: ぷらっと奈良
description: Maplat-based walking map viewer overlaying historical maps of Nara City (Nara) on the modern map.

name: みたか温故知新マップ
description: Maplat-based local history map of Mitaka City (Tokyo) digitizing the 三鷹まるごと博物館マップ with old maps, chronology and seasonal topics; built under a Mitaka City industry-academia-government grant.

name: 山形アーカイブ (Yamagata Archive)
description: Digital archive of Yamagata town memories (photos, documents, historical maps) from Yamagata University Museum and regional partners, browsable on a Maplat map interface comparing old and current maps.

name: Stroly
description: Hosted platform where museums, libraries and municipalities publish georeferenced historical and illustrated maps, viewed overlaid on modern maps with GPS positioning.

name: eコミュニティ・プラットフォーム (eコミマップ)
owner_name: National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience
description: NIED's open-source participatory WebGIS: users overlay external layers (WMS, XYZ, TMS, KML) on GSI tiles, build disaster-prevention maps and publish them as open data; basis of the 官民協働危機管理クラウド.

name: 20万分の1日本シームレス地質図 (1:200,000 Seamless Geological Map of Japan)
description: AIST/GSJ seamless geological map viewer for Japan (1:200,000) with 2D/3D viewers and legend-based layer switching; sibling product of the registered GeoNavi on the same host.
